items.title: Faces and Coach Poses
items.why:
I cut your two new sheets into separate pictures and removed their white backgrounds.

The faces come two ways: as drawn, with hair breaking out past the circle, or trimmed neatly to the circle. Both are shown in the real app below.

The coach poses have their words (Setup Coach, Let's Train! and so on) painted into the picture. That's great for a big moment, but those words can never change, and they repeat what the app already says. So each pose also comes without its banner.

I can't draw better versions than ChatGPT; my own drawings are the ones you called homemade. What I can do is cut, trim and fit these, and suggest where each one goes. For the other 13 fighters, ask ChatGPT for the same style and I'll fit them the same way.

items.title: Hair Out, or Inside the Circle?
items.why: Your Goku face in the real app: the profile chip (with the Super Saiyan 3 flames) and the You card.

options.label: Hair breaks out of the circle
options.desc: More personality; it pokes past the edge.

options.label: Trimmed to the circle
options.desc: Neater; every avatar is the same round shape.

items.title: Goku, Vegeta, Piccolo and Master Roshi
items.why: These replace the kanji emblems for these four fighters. The other 14 fighters keep their emblems until their faces arrive.

items.title: Where Should Goku Asleep Go?
items.why: He isn't a fighter to pick, so he needs a spot of his own.

options.label: On the Rest Day card
options.desc: The card you see after logging a rest day.

options.label: On the sleep question in the check-in

items.title: The Setup Coach
items.why: Goku pointing at you replaces the capsule mascot in the setup chat. Shown in the real setup screen.

options.label: Pointing pose with "Setup Coach"
options.desc: The words get small in the chat bubble.

items.title: Banners On the Big Moments?
items.why: For the moments below, the painted words could be the headline, since they fit (Let's Train!, You Got This!, Rest Day). Or every pose goes without words, and the app writes its own.

options.label: Words on the big moments only
options.desc: Let's Train!, You Got This! and Rest Day keep their banners; the rest go without.

items.title: Let's Train!
items.why: Proposed spot: At the top of the workout screen when you tap Enter the Chamber, before the first move. I'll show it in the real screen before publishing.

items.title: You Got This!
items.why: Proposed spot: On the screen after you finish a workout, above your reps and the ghost result. I'll show it in the real screen before publishing.

items.title: Rest Day
items.why: Proposed spot: On the card that appears after you log a rest day. I'll show it in the real screen before publishing.

items.title: Relax & Recharge
items.why: Proposed spot: On Home on a planned rest day, or when your check-in says you need recovery. I'll show it in the real screen before publishing.

items.title: Pro Tips
items.why: Proposed spot: At the top of the "Why?" explanation sheets. I'll show it in the real screen before publishing.
